title: GoOrganicAfrica calculator readiness evidence batch 04
scope: Successful indexed retrieval and table-level extraction from Benin's official 2023-2024 agricultural campaign report, plus confirmation of Senegal's public EAA 2024-2025 interactive statistical tables. National historical production/yield evidence is recorded as research evidence only; no regional enterprise budgets or current input/farmgate prices are certified.

countries.name: Benin

sources.title: INStaD / DSA - Les chiffres définitifs de la campagne agricole 2023-2024
sources.findings: Official DSA campaign report dated March 2024. Search-indexed PDF text was successfully retrieved and table/paragraph values were extracted. Crop statistics derive from the Agricultural Statistical Survey conducted by DSA with departmental agriculture directorates; report states 10,245 agricultural holdings across 683 agricultural enumeration zones.

sources.title: INStaD agricultural statistics catalogue
sources.findings: Catalogue page lists the definitive 2023-2024 report and related agricultural statistics.

extracted_national_observations.note: Report states maize yield was the lowest since 2018; do not treat as a regional yield.
Production only in this extracted record; selected graph values require careful chart transcription.

Conflicting values in the same official report: summary table reports 421,886 tonnes for 2023 and 520,929 for 2022, while narrative and detailed Table 5 report 520,929 tonnes for 2023 and 421,886 for 2022. Withheld from numeric use pending source-owner clarification.

verified_facts: The report's production statistics are based on DSA's Agricultural Statistical Survey and departmental agriculture directorates; it records 10,245 holdings across 683 agricultural enumeration zones.
Selected crop yield values are available for maize, yam, cassava, cowpea/beans, groundnut, soybean, tomato, chilli pepper, okra and onion.
The report is national-level in the extracted tables; regional crop values, dated farmgate prices and complete input/enterprise budgets were not extracted.
The report contains some internal inconsistencies in narrative/table reference labels and typographic values; retain the stated source year and validate source table/page before production use.
Soybean production is internally inconsistent: the summary table reverses the values shown in the narrative and detailed Table 5; no soybean figure is certified until reconciled.
blockers: Extract regional crop area, production and yield from ESA 2024 / RNA tables and reconcile against the national campaign report.
Resolve discrepancies and verify chart/table readings against page images before calculator mapping.
Obtain dated farmgate prices and farmer-facing seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs by region.
Build region-specific enterprise budgets and tests; current national observations alone do not support regional profit estimates.
Resolve the soybean production value discrepancy between the report's summary table and narrative/detailed Table 5 before using the figure.

countries.name: Senegal

sources.title: FAO AGRISurvey Senegal - access to data
sources.findings: Official FAO access page links the EAA 2024-2025 interactive statistical tables, historical 2018-2023 thematic tables and dashboard, and the ANADS survey catalogue.

sources.title: Senegal EAA 2024-2025 ANADS catalogue
sources.findings: Official survey metadata confirms coverage across all regions and 45 departments. In the anonymised data, region remains available while department is replaced by agroecological zone. The 2024-2025 survey includes production, area, yield, inputs, labour and ILP topics.

sources.title: Senegal EAA 2024-2025 related materials
sources.findings: Official questionnaires, enumerator manual and local-to-standard conversion workbook ZIP are listed. The EAA 2024-2025 analysis report is listed without a download URL.

sources.title: Senegal EAA 2024-2025 interactive tables - FAO linked Open Data for Africa portal
sources.findings: The official FAO page's interactive-table link resolves to this DAPSA-tagged portal gallery, but direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 during this review; no numeric table values could be extracted.

verified_facts: Public interactive statistical tables for EAA 2024-2025 are linked from FAO's official Senegal access-to-data page.
The survey metadata confirms region remains in the anonymised file; department is replaced by agroecological zone.
The survey covers the 14 regions and 45 departments; public table extraction and unit conversion are still pending.
Do not infer that the presence of an interactive-table link means all required price and input cost tables have been extracted.
Direct access to the DAPSA-tagged Senegal Open Data for Africa gallery returned HTTP 403 in this retrieval attempt; link presence is confirmed but table contents were not accessible for extraction.
blockers: Resolve access to the public DAPSA Open Data for Africa gallery (HTTP 403) or obtain published aggregate tables through an alternate official download route.
Open and extract the public EAA 2024-2025 interactive tables by region, crop, season, area, production and yield.
Obtain and apply the official local measurement conversion workbooks before comparing yield or price units.
Extract permitted aggregate input, labour and cost tables; do not download or redistribute restricted confidential microdata.
Obtain dated regional farmgate prices and complete enterprise budgets, then add calculator mapping and tests.

safeguards: No confidential microdata was downloaded, stored or redistributed.
No missing crop, price or cost value was invented.
National historical statistics are not presented as regional values or current market prices.
The 10 active calculator profiles and calculator formulas remain untouched.
Neither Benin nor Senegal is certified calculator-ready.
next_batch: Extract regional tables from Benin ESA 2024 and Senegal EAA 2024-2025 public interactive tables; obtain unit conversion tables; then continue with country-by-country regional price and input-cost validation.
